definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. upp-þot a great stir; þytr a sound.

quotations.old_english: Geonung, geþota (pl. n.? or sing. m.?), rárung barritus

source_text: ge-þot (?), es; n.: ge-þota (?), an; m. A shout, howl :-- Geonung, geþota (pl. n.? or sing. m.?), rárung barritus, Wrt. Voc. ii. 125, 19. [Cf. Icel. upp-þot a great stir; þytr a sound.] v. þeótan.
